title: Assignment followed by a program
statement: Let a limit record, program, execution depth, memory function $\mu$, budget $T$, postcondition $Q$, local function $\mathrm{loc}$, index $x$, expression $e$, statement $s$, and integer $z$ be given. If $s$ can execute from the state obtained by updating local position $x$ to $z$ in $(\mathrm{loc},\mu)$, with cost at most $T-(\mathrm{cost}(e)+1)$, and its final state satisfies $Q$, and if $e$ is safe in $(\mathrm{loc},\mu)$ and evaluates there to $z$, with $\mathrm{cost}(e)+1\le T$, then assigning $e$ to position $x$ and then executing $s$ can execute from $(\mathrm{loc},\mu)$ with cost at most $T$ and final state satisfying $Q$.
hypotheses_covered: The continuation s executes from the state with local position x set to z and memory μ, within budget T − (cost(e)+1), and ends in a state satisfying Q.
Expression e is safe in (loc, μ) and evaluates there to z.
